sources.takeaway: Search campaign language targeting removal begins September2026. Localized creatives and landing pages are central; do not treat an English PMax setting as all-language exclusion on Search.

Phrase negatives exclude matching ordered phrases. Synonyms, translations and singular/plural are not automatic. Casing and misspellings already handled; accent variants may differ. Protect genuine apparel queries.
Presence focuses on people likely in or regularly in target countries, reducing interest-only cross-border reach. Signals are not 100% accurate; country reporting still required.
